authorization.statement: I authorize the one-time Phase 12 sealed confirmation under Amendment 07, with the runner and sealed feature builder code named in this record.

baseline.definition: Ridge(alpha=1.0) on Volatility, spy_volatility_20 after training-quantile clipping [0.01, 0.99] and StandardScaler; the Stage 2 reference model
baseline.fit: all development rows, Stage 2 fit_finalist procedure; fitted in Stage 3A from development data only because Stage 2 saved candidates only; deterministic (two fits identical)
baseline.name: baseline_ridge_vol

calibration_boundary: the finalist is evaluated uncalibrated; any product calibration must be developed on Stage 2 development out-of-fold predictions, frozen separately, and never tuned on sealed results

criteria_review.Q2: kept; the family is 1 comparison, so Holm leaves p unchanged
criteria_review.Q4: adapted: there is no walk-forward, so the gap check becomes the train/sealed separation check
criteria_review.Q5: adapted: 'best fold' becomes 'best quarter', the same 63-session length as a Stage 2 fold, since the sealed period has no folds
criteria_review.Q6: adapted: no refit happens, so reproducibility is checked on the frozen artifacts and on repeated inference

eligibility_and_missing_data.features: a row is excluded when any of the 8 features is non-finite or the generator marks it uncovered (e.g. no covered 20-session news window); excluded rows are dropped for finalist and baseline alike; no imputation, forward-fill or zero-fill
eligibility_and_missing_data.limits: excluded rows > 1% of all rows or > 5% of any stock's rows -> INVALID
eligibility_and_missing_data.order: validity is decided before any prediction is compared with a target
eligibility_and_missing_data.sessions: all stocks must share the same sealed sessions; fewer than 400 -> INVALID
eligibility_and_missing_data.targets: a non-finite Close or SPY_Close at t or t+1 -> INVALID (prices are verified snapshots)
eligibility_and_missing_data.universe: the 29 Phase 11B stocks; a missing stock or SPY series -> INVALID
eligibility_and_missing_data.zero_counts: zero news or event counts are values, not missing data

evidence_levels.development_qualification: Stage 2, 2019-02 .. 2024-09 walk-forward on development data. Exploratory and possibly optimistic: the 8 features were chosen in Stage 1 on the same 2017-2024 data.
evidence_levels.sealed_confirmation: This amendment: one evaluation of the frozen finalist on sessions never used for feature selection, model fitting, scaling or threshold setting. Only this result can confirm the Stage 2 finding.

finalist.trained_on: all development rows, labels complete by 2024-09-30 (Stage 2 fit_finalist)

inference: verify each artifact's SHA256 before unpickling
build the 8 features for every (stock, sealed session) with the frozen generators (sealed_feature_build)
the other 6 features are z-scored per stock with that stock's stored DEVELOPMENT mean and std (ddof 0, std 0 -> 1); no sealed statistic is ever computed for scaling
columns in features_in_order; estimator.predict; predictions floored at 0
the baseline is applied the same way to its 2 features
no fit, partial_fit, refit, recalibration or threshold choice on any sealed row
metrics: relative MSE and MAE improvement over the baseline
per-stock and per-block relative MSE improvement
ranking (descriptive): pooled Spearman(prediction, actual); mean per-date cross-sectional Spearman
calibration (descriptive): prediction deciles; top-5% moves mean predicted / mean actual; bottom-50% moves; residual skew

outcomes.INVALID: an integrity or eligibility rule fails before any prediction is compared with a target; no metric is computed or written; a repeat needs a written addendum whose fix does not depend on sealed outcomes
outcomes.NOT_CONFIRMED: valid run, any of Q1-Q6 fails; final, never re-run with changes

prohibitions: retraining or refitting any model on sealed rows
feature, preprocessing, horizon or baseline changes
a second confirmation run after a valid one

qualification.Q1_improvement: relative MSE improvement >= 0.01 AND relative MAE improvement >= 0.0
qualification.Q2_statistics: DM p < 0.05 AND p with lag 2L < 0.05
qualification.Q3_periods: MSE better in >= 3 of 4 equal consecutive blocks of sealed dates
qualification.Q4_separation: artifacts trained only on rows with labels <= 2024-09-30; every evaluated row has t >= 2024-10-01 and t+1 <= 2026-09-25; no estimator is fitted during the run
qualification.Q5_breadth: MSE improved for >= 60% of stocks, and still > 0 without the best stock and without the best quarter (63-session chunks of sealed dates; a final chunk < 21 merged into the previous one)
qualification.Q6_reproducibility: artifact and model fingerprints and development prediction fingerprints match the pins, and a second in-process inference on the sealed rows is bit-identical
qualification.rule: CONFIRMED only if Q1-Q6 all pass

requirements: calls the generator files in pins.generator_code_sha256 unchanged (hash-checked at run time)
event labels from rules_v1 (spec hash pinned); no FinBERT or any other model is run
sentiment scores are not an input of any of the 8 features; where a generator needs one a constant placeholder is passed
UTX->RTX mapping and the news alignment and prediction-timestamp rules exactly as in 11B.3
before any sealed row is emitted, the builder rebuilds the development period and must reproduce the 8 columns of the frozen 11B development frames exactly (bit-identical); otherwise it stops
outputs only Date, Close, SPY_Close and the 8 features for sealed-window sessions
sealed_feature_build.status: NOT YET WRITTEN (training/phase12_sealed_features.py); reviewed and approved separately before authorization

sealed_window.lookback: rolling features at t may use sessions before 2024-10-01 (as in development); no feature uses information after the session-t prediction timestamp
sealed_window.prediction_dates: common sessions t with 2024-10-01 <= t and t+1 <= 2026-09-25

statistics.test: one-sided Diebold-Mariano, H0: finalist squared error not lower than the baseline's, on the per-date cross-sectional mean loss differential
statistics.variance: Newey-West, Bartlett, lag L = max(1, ceil(T^(1/3))), T = sealed dates; 2L sensitivity

status: FROZEN before any sealed observation is read
target: y = |(Close[t+1]/Close[t] - 1) - (SPY_Close[t+1]/SPY_Close[t] - 1)|: excess_return_v1 at h=1 (training.excess_targets.build_excess_targets), absolute value; Close = the frozen snapshot close
